overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee answered a minutes request within six days and said minutes would be posted within 10 days, and the complaint was filed before that window closed, so actual availability was not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to timely respond to a March 28, 2024 request for the minutes of its March 27, 2024 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Committee responded to the request within six days and advised that minutes would be available within the 10 day timeframe.

allegations.summary: Whether the requested minutes were actually made available within 10 days of the request, since the complaint was filed before that window closed.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed less than 10 days after the request was made, we do not review whether the requested minutes were actually made available within 10 days, and we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
